THE EMPOWERING, NO-NONSENSE MEMOIR THAT CELEBRATES POWERFUL, INSPIRATIONAL WOMEN FROM EASTENDERS LEGEND LACEY TURNER.
Lacey Turner burst onto television screens in 2004, starring as the feisty, outspoken and much-loved Stacey Slater. For more than two decades, she has been at the heart of some of EastEnders’ most-watched storylines, including her heart-wrenching romances with Bradley Branning and Martin Fowler, her role in ‘The Six’, featuring Albert Square’s most powerful women, and her moving portrayal of bipolar disorder.

Both on and off screen, Lacey has been defined by strong, fearless, inspiring women, from the matriarchs in her own life to the EastEnders legends who guided her early career on the show. Now, in Gold Dust, Lacey invites you into the unforgettable moments that have shaped her.

Filled with behind-the-scenes gossip and hilarious anecdotes, hear ‘life wisdom’ from EastEnders icons including Barbara Windsor and June Brown, learn how Lacey’s iconic Nanny Chick inspired Stacey’s spiritedness and glimpse the reality of growing up in the public eye.

Gold Dust is an uplifting celebration and a reminder that women are just as precious as gold dust.
